instruments.notes: Cost free collar ('Enron Hedge') on NYMEX Light Sweet Crude Oil Futures average monthly price. Text is truncated before the start date and volume ramp; states volume reaches 14,000 Bbls in December 2000. Remaining exposure after Koch offset limited to Jan-Dec 1997 settlements at 10,900 barrels per month. Floor was lowered from $18.00 to $16.50 for Feb-Dec 1996 via restructuring.
instruments.evidence_quote:
monthly price,
based on NYMEX Light Sweet Crude Oil Futures Contracts, is between $18.00 and
$20.55 per barrel, no payment is due under the contract.

instruments.notes: Offsetting contract entered Jan 1, 1997 for $34,170 that exactly offsets the Enron Hedge collar for Jan 1998 through Dec 2000. Terms of the offset not otherwise stated.
instruments.evidence_quote:
On January 1, 1997, the Company paid $34,170 to
enter into a contract with Koch Gas Services Company ("Koch") that exactly
offsets the effect of the Enron Hedge during the period January 1998 through
December 2000.

instruments.notes: Purchased July 8, 1996 for $133,200; settles in monthly amounts of 60,000 put options. Text states put options, not explicitly barrels.
instruments.evidence_quote:
the Company purchased from Koch
720,000 put options for $133,200 with a strike price of $15.00. The contract
settles in monthly amounts of 60,000 put options during the period January 1997
to December 1997.

instruments.counterparty: Enron Capital and Trade Resources Corp.
instruments.notes: Settled as of Dec 31, 1996. Purchased for $149,000; monthly amounts escalating from 10,000 to 35,000 barrels. Counterparty per text on the three Enron Capital and Trade Resources contracts.
instruments.evidence_quote:
Under the final contract, the Company purchased for $149,000 an additional
257,000 put options with a strike price of $16.50 covering the period February
through December 1996 in monthly amounts escalating from 10,000 barrels to
35,000 barrels during the contract period.

instruments.notes: Cost free collar entered Nov 20, 1995; 12,000 barrels each month; settled as of Dec 31, 1996.
instruments.evidence_quote:
entered into a cost free collar with Koch that hedged 12,000 barrels of crude
oil production each month during the period December 1995 to December 1996.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Company entered price protection agreements to hedge against volatility in crude oil prices; hedging results are recorded as an adjustment to crude oil revenue. Hedging reduced 1996 oil and gas sales by $535,000.
